summary.en-US: Ad-free video & music player with browser, games, PDF tools and vault

description.en-US:
TM Player (Turbo Media Player) is a free, open-source and completely ad-free video and music player for Android — with a built-in web browser, offline games, a document reader with PDF tools, and an AI assistant hub — developed by MD. Muklash Mia.

Videos and music are scanned across ALL storage volumes — internal storage, SD card and USB pendrives (OTG). Pull down on the home screen to refresh the library.

New in v0.3:
*  17 offline games in their own tab — 2048, Ludo, Snakes & Ladders, Minesweeper, Carrom and more, with Vs AI and 2-player modes
*  AI Hub: ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, DeepSeek, Grok, Perplexity, Copilot and Meta AI in one place — log in with your own account, and add your own AI sites
*  Custom AI assistant with voice chat — connect any OpenAI-compatible service with your own key (Groq, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, your own server…)
*  TM Documents Reader: a PDF viewer (zoom to 300%, page jump) plus tools — merge, split / extract / reorder pages, compress, PDF to images, images to PDF, rotate, watermark, page numbers, signature stamping and metadata cleaning, all on-device
*  QR code scanner (in the Me tab)
*  Vault unlock your way: PIN, password, pattern, fingerprint or face
*  Background music playback with lock-screen controls
*  Auto-update: the app can check GitHub for new versions and update itself (optional, in Settings)

TM Browser:
*  Tabs and incognito tabs, bookmarks and history grouped by day
*  Ad and popup blocking with a 30,000-domain blocklist and optional ad-blocking DNS
*  Download manager: live progress and speed, pause / resume, background downloads with notifications, a download folder you can change (SD card supported) — and files keep their real names and extensions on every site
*  Page media finder — play or download the videos, images and files a page offers
*  Saved pages for offline reading, desktop / mobile mode, night mode, text size, orientation lock
*  Search engines: Google, DuckDuckGo, Bing and more, plus your own custom engines
*  App links behave: Play Store and other app links open the installed app when there is one, with a web fallback when there is not

Player features:
*  PLAYit-style home: list or grid view, month grouping, sort by date, name, size or duration, watch history with one-tap clear
*  Folders, playlists and search across every volume
*  Gesture player: brightness / volume / seek swipes, double-tap skip (5–30 s), long-press speed boost, playback speeds 0.25x–4.0x
*  Screenshot button, HDR Enhance colour boost, picture-in-picture, background play, sleep timer
*  Music player with albums, artists, folders, playlists and a mini player
*  Private Vault for your videos, hidden from the gallery
*  Recycle Bin, Media Manage storage overview and a junk Clean page
*  Video to MP3/audio converter
*  Themes: dark/light, accent colours and your own photo theme
*  No ads, no tracking, no accounts. The player, games and document tools work fully offline; the browser, AI features and the update check only connect when you use them. The camera is used only by the QR scanner.

TM Player is an original work built on Android's public APIs (QR scanning uses the open-source ZXing library, Apache 2.0). Playback uses your device's built-in codecs. Works on Android 8–17.
